text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ahh. The wind that blows at higher
altitudes
makes for a far more refreshing
breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh? I had no idea this town had such a
tall
building in it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If I went to its top floor and felt the
wind blowing
there, I might be able to bathe
in a more abiding
breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, I've made it to the top, but
none of
the windows are open.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I can get out on the deck
somehow.
Perhaps I should ask
someone...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Um... Excuse me? I'd like to step outside.
Would
you mind telling me how to do
that?

text_block_list.name: Employee
text_block_list.text:
If you're looking for the exit, there's a
one-way
elevator to the bottom over
there.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's not what I mean. I'd like to
bathe in the winds out on the
observation deck. Is there a
door
somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Employee
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, outside outside? Well, there is a stairwell leading outside, but you do realize the winds are very strong, right?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really? Thank you very much for
your help!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr immediately dashes off
to the
area outside the observation
deck, but...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Wow... What a vigorous gale. It must be
because
of this high altitude.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I hope that someday, I, too, will be able
to stir up
such a welkin wind!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If I am to accomplish that feat, I must
commit this
sensation to memory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr's running improves
markedly
after being inspired by the
rousing, high-altitude
wind.
